newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's Archer says underwriter resigns.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's Archer says underwriter resigns.

text.p: Archer Group Holdings, which operates one of the largest managing agencies in the Lloyds of London insurance market, said on Thursday that one of its underwriters had resigned.
The company said in a statement that Peter Routledge had resigned as underwriter of Syndicate 866.

"Archer is currently reviewing the position with a view to announcing the appointment of a new underwriter as soon as possible. In the meantime Alan Santry, the deputy underwriter, will take over in the short term," it added.
No-one was immediately available for comment at Archers, but the statement said the company would make a further announcement in due course.
Syndicate 866 specialises in motor insurance, has 96 million stg of capacity -- maximum premium income -- in 1996 and 180 employees.

The syndicate had an above average 1993 result, the most recent year for which Lloyd's syndicate results are available, Syndicate Underwriting Research Limited said of 866's 15.4 percent profit before a special Lloyd's levy.
Routledge has been involved in efforts to raise Lloyd's profile in the motor insurance market.
